subtasks.title: count words that appear exactly once
subtasks.goal: Add a public function once_words to src/count.rs that returns how many whitespace-separated words appear exactly once in the text, comparing words case-insensitively and ignoring surrounding punctuation the same way unique_words does. The repository's tests/behaviour.rs already calls count::once_words and is currently failing to compile; make those assertions pass without editing the test file. Keep every existing function and test in src/count.rs unchanged and green.

dod.statement: test/behaviour.rs compiles and its word-count assertions pass with the counting rule implemented in src/count.rs

subtasks.title: print the once-only count in the binary
subtasks.goal: In src/main.rs print a line 'once: N' after the existing three lines, using count::once_words from the previous subtask. Read the file the same way the other counts do, print it in the same format, and do not change the usage message or the existing three lines. The project must still build and its tests must still pass.

dod.statement: the binary prints the once-only count and the whole project still builds and tests green
